props.name: empty
props.comment: Rendered with no records, in place of `ListNoResults`.

props.name: iconSource
props.comment: The field whose value picks a component from `iconMap`.

props.name: linkType
props.comment:
Where a row links to when `onSelect` is not given. `edit` by default,
`show` when the resource has no edit view, and an inert row when it has
neither. `false` leaves rows inert.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Rendered while the list is pending, in place of `SimpleListLoading`.

props.name: onSelect
props.comment: Called with the record when a row is selected, in place of navigating.

props.name: parentSource
props.comment: The field holding the parent's id; a dotted path reads a nested value.

props.name: titleSource
props.comment: The string field shown as the row title; the record representation otherwise.
